title: Cobbled Community
description: Group of passionate developers providing the largest Minecraft minigames server in Australia.
body:
# Cobbled Community
**Working on the latest & largest minigames server in australia**

## Minigames (Alpha)
Currently in alpha we have ported our games to 1.21.11 to enjoy all the latest features modern minecraft has to offer. We have so far ported 20 out of the 40 minigames we plan to support in Beta, so far we have:

- **Skywars**
Now with spears!
- **Parkour Run**
- **Sabotage**
- **Bingo**
- **Block Hunt**
- **Dicey Heights**
- **Build Rush**
- **Micro Battle**
- **Bed Wars**
With all the new weapons and revised progression with copper and netherite tools.
- **item-hunt**
- **deathrun**
- **dragon-onslaught**
- **snake**
- **fortress**
- **Spleef**
- **Koth**
- **quakecraft**
- **color-swap**
- **destroy the monument**

_We owe a huge thanks to open source and the nucleoid project for providing an amazing foundation for minigames on our side of the planet! [Check them out here](https://nucleoid.xyz/). We upstream as many changes as we can but we do have some changes specific to our servers you can view in [our github](https://github.com/Cobbled-Community)._

## Perpetual SMP

We have run our survival server for over a year now since the start of 1.21.4 updated to 1.21.11 and focus on providing a clean experience for the casual players and builders. With custom server additions provided through polymer such as: tables, plushies, warp potions and much more, while still staying true to vanilla gameplay. 

With true vanilla gameplay we dont break builds for technical players either, no breaking farms, orbital cannons or limiting your creativity (within reason.. please dont build another 70k tnt nuke.) While still providing a stable server and performance for everyone involved.

**We hope to see you here and have so many plans on making a great experience for all players!**
